title: haworthia decipiens var. exilis

It is known for its small size, rounded and fleshy leaves with white or pale green stripes, making it a highly sought-after ornamental plant. The health benefits of Haworthia decipiens var. exilis are largely anecdotal, but some reports suggest that it may exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing.
